inspiration.purpose: Give a moving product composition depth and separation while retaining a warm, restrained environment.
beats: A broad dark warm field supports the incoming phone.
Graphic discs expand independently behind the hero and captions.
Shaped reflections define edges and surfaces while the composition changes.
use_when: Reflective product materials need clear form against a restrained field.
Light and environment motion can support the same attention target as typography.
inspiration.attention: Keep the hero silhouette and reading lanes clear; let the background support them.

sections.title: Object light versus background
items: Local Blender area lights shape the phone and metal reflections. AE blurred ellipse layers create the background field. Graphic discs are separate shapes.
Text color and glow have their own lifetimes. Do not treat glow, physical illumination and an expanding disc as interchangeable.

sections.title: Local light recipe
items: The scene script specifies light positions, rectangular dimensions, colors and aim targets. Keep scene scale, geometry, exposure and lights together when adapting.
Selected local values below are reproduction evidence, not recovered source settings. The complete setup also includes a 170W quiet front fill and 700W rear rim.

sections.title: Bounds and inspection
items: Opening field precomps were padded to 2560×2160 for 1280×720 output to remove visible rectangular edges. Recheck the largest blur and transform after adaptation.
Inspect glancing phone poses and reflective edges, not only a frontal settled frame. Compare new lighting with the action and camera held fixed.
